title: c40p: c39p core behind the plain wrapper; two-log ceiling 109.2761084: 2^115.962982262

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x from T=[x]P0 with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64) x 10 x (2^113.9990290835+2^66) < 2^115.962982262 score units (C=2,000): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. A run gate (u < K = 7196619466409573109, (K/2^64) x 0.999668 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.999668 and costs at most 10 x (2^125.000681035+2^66) < 2^128.322609130 units. Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
